title: Ethyl Gallate Isolated from Castanopsis cuspidata var. sieboldii Branches Inhibits Melanogenesis and Promotes Autophagy in B16F10 Cells.
authors: Choi, Moon-Hee; Yang, Seung-Hwa; Kim, Da-Song; Kim, Nam-Doo; Shin, Hyun-Jae
one_liner_zh: 该文研究乙基没食子酸抑制黑色素生成和促进自噬的化妆品功能，涉及蘑菇酪氨酸酶分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The Castanopsis cuspidata var. sieboldii (CCS) plant grows predominantly in temperate regions of Asian countries, such as South Korea. Research on CCS has so far concentrated on the nutritional analysis, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammation properties of its branches. However, the isolation of compounds and structural elucidation of effective single molecules remain unexplored, necessitating further exploration of CCS branches. Therefore, this study demonstrates the antioxidant and antimelanogenic activity of a single substance of ethyl gallate (EG) isolated from CCS branch extracts. Notably, the antimelanogenic (whitening) activity of EG extracted from CCS branches remains unexplored. Tyrosinase inhibition, kinetic enzyme assays, and molecular docking studies were conducted using mushroom tyrosinase in order to examine the antioxidant mechanism and antimelanin activity of EG in B16F10 melanoma cells. Nontoxic EG concentrations were found to be below 5 microg/mL. While EG significantly reduced the levels of whitening-associated proteins, p-CREB, and p-PKA, it dose-dependently inhibited the expression of TYR, TRP-1, TRP-2, and transcription factor (MITF). In addition, EG downregulated melanogenetic gene expression and activated autophagy signals. Therefore, EG extracted from CCS branches could serve as a novel functional cosmetic material with antimelanogenic and autophagy-enhancing activity.
abstract_zh: Castanopsis cuspidata var. sieboldii（CCS）植物主要生长在亚洲国家的温带地区，如韩国。迄今为止，对CCS的研究主要集中在营养分析、抗氧化活性及其枝条的抗炎特性上。然而，化合物的分离和有效单一分子的结构解析仍未探索，有必要进一步研究CCS枝条。因此，本研究展示了从CCS枝条提取物中分离出的单一物质没食子酸乙酯（ethyl gallate, EG）的抗氧化和抗黑色素生成活性。值得注意的是，从CCS枝条中提取的EG的抗黑色素生成（美白）活性尚未被探索。本研究使用蘑菇酪氨酸酶进行了酪氨酸酶抑制、动力学酶测定和分子对接研究，以考察EG在B16F10黑色素瘤细胞中的抗氧化机制和抗黑色素活性。无毒的EG浓度被确定为低于5微克/毫升。虽然EG显著降低了与美白相关的蛋白p-CREB和p-PKA的水平，但它剂量依赖性地抑制了TYR、TRP-1、TRP-2和转录因子（MITF）的表达。此外，EG下调了黑色素生成基因的表达并激活了自噬信号。因此，从CCS枝条中提取的EG可能作为一种具有抗黑色素生成和增强自噬活性的新型功能性化妆品原料。
